factory_info.layout_description: A parallel production line laid out along the sequence Raw Material Intake -> Surface Treatment -> Packaging -> Cutting -> Assembly -> Machining, with stations grouped by workflow step.

parallel_groups.reasoning: Steps Cutting, Raw Material Intake do not share equipment or line dependencies, so they can run concurrently without blocking one another.
